data.name: Dharmander
data.gender_notes: Dharmander is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dharmander is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'dharma' and 'andar'. Dharma means righteousness, morality, and law, while andar means within. Thus, Dharmander signifies one who embodies righteousness and virtues from within. The name Dharmander carries the meaning “Righteous, just, and virtuous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharmander usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, just, and virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dharmander belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, just, and virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharmander total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
